chunks: When a man is in trouble, he prays to God; but when We bestow a favour on him he says: 'It has come to me through my acumen.' In fact, this is an illusion, but most men do not know.
ai.seo_question: How does human behavior change between hardship and prosperity according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, from Surah Az-Zumar, highlights the psychological shift in human nature between distress and ease, a theme central to Shia ethical teachings on humility (tawadu) and gratitude (shukr). The 'fitnah' mentioned is not merely a trial but a test of whether one recognizes divine grace as the sole source of success, rather than personal merit or knowledge. This duality serves as a reminder that material blessings can be as spiritually dangerous as hardships if they lead to arrogance.
